The Staff Selection Commission has released the SSC MTS Result 2026 on 3rd August at ssc.gov.in. This is for the Computer Based Test, which was held from 4th to 19th February 2026. A total of 8,04,633 candidates appeared in the exam for 7948 vacancies for the posts of Multi Tasking (Non Technical) Staff and Havaldar under SSC MTS Recruitment 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination can now download the SSC MTS Result PDF along with the cut off marks and check their roll number to know if they have qualified for next stage or not. Read this article to get complete information on SSC MTS Havaldar result 2026, merit list PDF, download link, scorecard and more.

SSC MTS Result 2026 Out @ssc.gov.in

Around 36.17 lakh candidates registered for the SSC MTS 2026 examination, which was conducted from 4th February 2026 across various centres in the country. The result has roll numbers and names of candidates who have qualified on the basis of their performance in the written exam. Candidates who cleared the CBT will move to the next stage of selection process. Those who applied for the Havaldar post must appear for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST), while candidates selected for Multi-Tasking Staff posts will be considered according to merit and available vacancies.

SSC MTS Result 2026 Download Link

The result link for the MTS post is active at the official portal of SSC. The commission has released the list in PDF format, and candidates need to manually search their roll number. It is important to download and keep a copy of the result PDF for future reference specially for physical tests or document verification.

How many Candidates Shortlisted for PET PMT for SSC Havldar

A total of 8071 candidates are shortlisted to appear for the Physical Test for the post of Havaldar. Out of the total, the results of 2 candidates have been withheld due to suspicious activities. Other than this, the results of 727 candidates have not been processed due to malpractice and 169 candidates have been debarred by SSC Regional Offices for various reasons.

How to Download ssc.gov.in MTS Havaldar Result 2026?

Candidates can follow the steps to download the SSC Havaldar Merit List PDF. The qualifying marks will be available too, along with the result.

Step 1: Go to the official website ssc.gov.in

Step 2: Click on the “Result” section on the homepage

Step 3: Choose the MTS examination tab

Step 4: Open the link for MTS & Havaldar Examination 2026 Result

Step 5: Download the PDF and search your roll number using Ctrl + F

Details Mentioned on the SSC MTS Result 2026

The SSC Havaldar Result PDF provides complete details of shortlisted candidates. Candidates must check their details carefully. For any mismatch, candidates should immediately contact the SSC regional office.

  • Name of the Commission
  • Examination Name
  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Name of the Category for which candidates applied

SSC MTS Cut Off Marks 2026

The SSC Multi-Tasking Staff cut off marks have been published separately along with the result. The qualifying marks vary depending on category and post. Only candidates who have scored equal to or above the qualifying marks will be considered qualified for PET/PST (for Havaldar) or further stages in MTS recruitment.

SSC MTS Havaldar Tie Resolution

The commission uses the tie-resolution if two or more candidates secure the same marks in the exam, in the following criteria:

  • Candidate with higher normalised marks in the General Awareness section of Session II.
  • Candidate with higher overall normalised marks in Session II.
  • Candidate who is older in age (based on Date of Birth).
  • If the tie remains, candidates will be ranked in alphabetical order of their names.

What’s Next After the SSC MTS Havaldar Result 2026?

After the SSC MTS Havaldar Result 2026, candidates who cleared the CBT will move to the next stage based on the post they applied for. The process is different for MTS and Havaldar posts.

Post Applied Next Stage What You Have to Do What Happens After That
MTS Document Verification Carry original certificates for age, qualification, category, etc. Final merit list is prepared and appointment process starts
Havaldar PET & PST Appear for running tests and physical measurement (height, chest for males, etc.) Candidates who qualify move to final merit list and further formalities

SSC MTS Score Card 2026

The marks of the qualified/non-qualified candidates will be uploaded on the website of the Commission after declaration of the final result. The candidates will be able to check the marks by logging in using their registration number and date of birth on the official website.

SSC MTS Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Where do I find SSC MTS Result 2026?

Ans: You can find SSC MTS havaldar result pdf in the article above. You can also download it via official Staff Selection Commission site. The result is in PDF format.

Q2. When will be the release of SSC MTS Result 2026?

Ans: The SSC MTS Result 2026 has been declared on 3rd August at ssc.gov.in.

Q3. How do I come to know about qualifying for SSC Havaldar Result?

Ans: You should download SSC MTS Havaldar result PDF and find your roll number there. It means that you have cleared the test if your roll number is available in the pdf.

Q4. Does the SSC MTS Result Pdf shows cut off marks?

Ans: Yes, the SSC MTS cut off marks will be declared with the result. You should score equal or above the cut off marks for the next stage.
